title: Gmail bill import
description: Find supported bills in your connected Gmail account and bring their details and originals into Rezlee.
response: The import flow is built. Verification and launch checks are being completed before customer access is enabled.

title: Pay bills in Rezlee
description: Pay supported household bills from the app and keep payment status alongside each bill.
response: We’re assessing this idea before committing to a build. Supported billers, payment partners and customer protections need to be worked through.

title: Rezlee card
description: A card for everyday household spending, with purchases organised alongside your bills and shared costs.
response: A proposed feature, not an available card. Issuing partners, eligibility, costs and protections would need to be established first.

title: Split one payment across multiple cards
description: Use more than one card to cover a single eligible bill or purchase, choosing the amount charged to each.
response: We need to establish what merchants and payment partners can support. There is no committed launch date.

title: Split actual payments with roommates
description: Let each roommate pay their share toward a household bill, with a clear view of what is paid and outstanding.
response: This would go beyond tracking who owes whom. Current shared expenses record balances and repayments; they do not move money.

title: More bill-provider connections
description: Connect more electricity, gas, water and telecom accounts so fewer bills need to be added manually.
response: Existing supported connections remain available. Votes and provider requests will help us choose which connections to add next.

title: Shared household budgets
description: Set monthly spending targets together and see how household bills and shared expenses compare with the budget.
response: We’re gathering interest before choosing the first budgeting tools to build. Tell us which spending categories matter most.

title: Contract renewal and price-change alerts
description: Get a heads-up before a bill contract renews or a promotional price ends, using dates saved in Rezlee.
response: A proposed extension to bill tracking. We need to make clear which dates come from a statement and which you confirm yourself.

title: Household maintenance calendar
description: See upcoming upkeep, recurring tasks and household assignments together in a calendar view.
response: Care tasks and routines are already available. This idea adds a shared calendar view to make planning ahead easier.

title: Shared expense groups
description: Keep separate balances for roommates, family or trips, with flexible splits and recorded repayments.
response: Available in the app: Shared expenses → View expense groups. Rezlee tracks amounts owed; it does not transfer money.

title: Realtor welcome-home gifts
description: Realtors can give clients a year of Rezlee Pro, activated through an invitation to the client’s verified email.
response: Available through the Rezlee team. The gift year starts when claimed, with no automatic renewal or access to the client’s private records.

title: Dark mode
description: Choose a light or dark appearance, or let Rezlee follow your phone’s setting.
response: Available in Settings → Appearance, including the roadmap and everyday household screens.
